---
title: 03. 변수선택
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
```

### 01.

```{r}
data <- read.csv("./data/ch03/ex3-1.csv")
head(data)

# 1)
cor(data[, c(-1, -8)])

# 2)
library(car)
model <- lm(EVAP ~ MAXST + MINST + AVST + MAXAT + MINAT + AVAT, data = data)
vif(model)
```

### 02.

```{r}
data <- read.csv("./data/ch03/ex3-2.csv")
head(data)

# 1)
cor(data[, -1])

# 2)
library(fmsb)
VIF(lm(X1 ~ X2 + X3 + X4 + X5 + X6, data = data))
VIF(lm(X2 ~ X1 + X3 + X4 + X5 + X6, data = data))
VIF(lm(X3 ~ X1 + X2 + X4 + X5 + X6, data = data))
VIF(lm(X4 ~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X5 + X6, data = data))
VIF(lm(X5 ~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4 + X6, data = data))
VIF(lm(X6 ~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4 + X5, data = data))
```
